freeze: Independent additive scientific/ABI oracle, written before any digital/counter native implementation is authored or read. Literal words and asymmetric arguments are hand-declared; no product encoder/decoder, SDK, compiler, native call or runtime.

abi_policy.return_status: signed i32; zero success, positive warning, negative failure
abi_policy.bool32: u32, including pointer target for reserved
abi_policy.calling_convention: fixed NI __CFUNC: C on Linux, system on Windows; no variadic attribute calls

positive_timeout_word.name: positive_read_timeout_control
positive_timeout_word.rule: An exactly representable independent positive timeout control. Actual Read receives positive original remaining duration, never this constant as a renewed budget.

one_scan_status_geometry_controls.result: Incomplete; preserve raw warning and geometry; no data block
original negative error; no data block
Incomplete; no data block; do not inspect unqualified words
Incomplete; no data block; do not inspect unqualified words
one complete scan/word and raw status retained before original error/deferred diagnostics
one complete scan/word plus raw warning; no extra native read from Finish

software_attempt_frontier_control.semantics: Each actual attempt owns one pre-FFI host start+interval frontier; early idle repeats frontier without SDK. Slow completion neither adds completion+interval nor triggers catchup bursts. No exact physical C-entry gap, fresh conversion, hardware sampling rate or RT guarantee.

clock_and_retention_contract.completion: Host monotonic sampled immediately after selected Read returns, before optional diagnostics/encoding/IPC. Preserve original clock for accepted data and exports. No device source_time.
clock_and_retention_contract.deadline: One original operation deadline and cutoff across setup/probes/read/publication. No native calls while early-idle; no Read in Finish; no retry/fallback/reconnect after terminal failure.
clock_and_retention_contract.diagnostics: Publish valid returned data/raw read status first. Deferred optional negative diagnostics precede other NI cleanup calls at Finish; diagnostic hang cannot erase received data or replace first code. Owned Stop/Clear only and cleanup uncertainty explicit.

legacy_preservation: All seven prior JSON byte hashes, all five C manual arrays (voltage, thermocouple, current, RTD, mixed eight-word), existing AI homogeneous/mixed rows and both timing modes remain unchanged.
qualification: Synthetic ABI/host lifecycle only. No physical NI USB/C-Series/chassis/OS/driver acceptance, routing/electrical/width readback beyond stated getter, simultaneity, missed-transition or real-time guarantee.
profile: one fresh owned whole-port digital INPUT task, explicit on_demand only; one separate port per task channel; no individual-line/packed-multiport/output profile

public_boundary.channels: 1..64 individual Device/portN strings, no ranges/lists/line names/MAX aliases

primary_sources.prototype: int32 __CFUNC DAQmxCreateDIChan(TaskHandle taskHandle, const char lines[], const char nameToAssignToLines[], int32 lineGrouping)

int32 __CFUNC DAQmxGetDINumLines(TaskHandle taskHandle, const char channel[], uInt32 *data)
int32 __CFUNC DAQmxGetNthTaskReadChannel(TaskHandle taskHandle, uInt32 index, char buffer[], int32 bufferSize)

identity_rules.physical_binding: Exact requested physical bytes go to that constructor; returned virtual read identity/order and observed width are independently checked. Do not label physical request as driver readback.

semantic_rules: Retain all four bytes/full unsigned word unchanged; no masking, signed cast or line-label expansion.
Unequal synthetic widths are metadata controls, not claims about DigitalSuccess hardware.
High bit and all-ones controls are on width32; no narrower-width padding assumption.
Each Read contains at most one complete scan, in validated task read order; repeated states remain.
DI setup may configure input direction/resources; no DO/write/reset/clock/export/takeover calls and no passive-monitor claim.
